run_training_benchmark: run a training benchmark comparing fp32 baseline against candidate settings with bf16 and throughput steps
run_TrainingBenchmarkRunner: run the TrainingBenchmarkRunner via fairchem CLI to benchmark training fidelity and throughput and save a JSON report
create_BenchmarkTrainCallback: create a TorchTNT callback that captures per-step training metrics including losses, grad norms, and step times
review_TrainingBenchmarkResult: review the TrainingBenchmarkResult dataclass containing fidelity and throughput metrics from a benchmark run
test_run_training_benchmark: test the run_training_benchmark function by comparing baseline fp32 loss and candidate bf16 loss with gradient norms
